main_text.l: Idem:Sit igitur,inquit,hoc persuasum omnibus, Dominos esse omnium rerum ac moderatores deos : eaq; quæ geratur, eorum geri ditione ac numine : eosdémque optimè de genere humano mereri: & qualis quisque sit,quid agat,quid in se admittat,qua mente,qua pietate religiones colat, piorum & impiorum habere ra-tionem. De Nat.Deorum.

Galenus de usu partium : Arbitror in eo esse ueram pietatem,non taurorum he-catombas Deo plures sacrificare, & ca-sias aliaq; sexcenta odorameta & ungué-ta suffumigare: sed si nouerim ipse pri-mus,deinde & aliis exposuerim,quæ'nā sitipsius sapientia,quæ uirtus,quæ boni-tas? Quód enim cultu conueniente ex-ornare omnia, nihilq; suis beneficijs pri-uatum esse uoluerit,id perfectissimæ bo-nitatis specimen esse statuo. Et hac qui-dem ratione bonitas eius hymnis est no-bis celebranda. Hoc autē inuenisse, quo pacto omnia potissimùm adornarentur, summæ sapientiæ est: effecisse autem omnia quæ uoluit,uirtutis est inuictæ atq; infuperabilis.

page.notes: The printed "6." between the signature and the catchword is not a page number and is not transcribed as one. The page number at top right is a worn old-style numeral; read as 21 with doubt. Doubtful readings: "odorameta" and "inuictæ" are read from a faint scan; "quæ'nā" is as printed. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens.
